errors.text_span: Общо има 2 основни категории и 12 по-малки категории.
errors.evidence: The figure has 3 main categories (Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, Real Characters) and 16 subcategories, not 2 main categories and 12 subcategories.

errors.text_span: Във външния кръг има 6 еднакви по размер сектора, всеки със син цвят, които са етикетирани като: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, Game Characters.
errors.evidence: The outer circle contains 5 blue segments for Virtual Characters, not 6.

errors.text_span: Вътрешният кръг е разделен на четири сектора: три от тях са в зелен цвят и са етикетирани като Real Characters с по-малки етикети: Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, Influencers; един сектор е в червен цвят и е етикетиран като Custom Characters; последният сектор е в син цвят и е етикетиран като Virtual Characters.
errors.evidence: The inner circle is divided into three sectors: Virtual Characters (blue), Custom Characters (red), and Real Characters (green). The description incorrectly states four sectors.
The machine-generated description does not mention the lighter shades in the outer circle corresponding to the inner circle's colors.
The description omits the fact that the Custom Characters segment in the outer circle is unmarked.
The machine-generated description does not explain the purpose of the chart, which is to categorize different types of characters.

errors.text_span: Няма сектори с визуално подчертани елементи като процентни етикети или различни размери.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that there are no visually emphasized elements, but the segmentation and color differentiation are visually emphasized features.

errors.text_span: The chart represents a Venn diagram showing the relationship between virtual characters and real characters
errors.evidence: The figure is a pie chart, not a Venn diagram. There is no overlapping of sections as described.

errors.text_span: which overlap to form a red section labeled 'Custom Characters'
errors.evidence: The red section labeled 'Custom Characters' does not overlap with the other sections; it is a distinct segment in the pie chart.
The machine-generated description does not state that the chart categorizes different types of characters into three main groups: Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, and Real Characters.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the 'Virtual Characters' section occupies about 3/4th of the chart.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the 'Custom Characters' section does not have any labeled subgroups in the outer circle.
The machine-generated description does not mention that the chart lacks a legend and percentage labels inside the slices.
The machine-generated description does not mention that there is no visual emphasis such as exploding or offsetting of any slice.

errors.text_span: Es gibt zwei Hauptkreise: einen inneren Kreis mit zwei Segmenten und einen äußeren Kreis mit sechs Segmenten.
errors.evidence: The inner circle has three segments (Virtual Characters, Custom Characters, Real Characters), not two. The outer circle has 16 segments, not six.

errors.text_span: Der innere Kreis ist in 'Real Characters' (grün) und 'Custom Characters' (rot) unterteilt.
errors.evidence: The inner circle includes 'Virtual Characters' (blue), 'Custom Characters' (red), and 'Real Characters' (green). The description omits 'Virtual Characters.'

errors.text_span: 'Real Characters' enthält sechs Subsegmente: Influencers, Actors, Musicians, Writers, Athletes und Artists
errors.evidence: The 'Real Characters' section contains seven subsegments, including 'Scientists,' which is omitted in the description.

errors.text_span: 'Custom Characters' ist ein kleines Segment ohne Subkategorien.
errors.evidence: The 'Custom Characters' section is a small segment but is part of the inner circle and does not extend into the outer circle. The description incorrectly implies it is part of the outer circle.
The description does not state the chart's purpose, which is to categorize different character types into three main groups.
The description does not mention the total number of segments (16) or the division of the outer circle into lighter shades corresponding to the inner circle's colors.
The description does not mention the lack of numerical values or percentages in the chart.

errors.text_span: Die Segmente sind in keiner bestimmten Reihenfolge angeordnet.
errors.evidence: The statement is vague and does not clarify the structural organization of the chart, which is grouped by character type.
